items.title: Dave Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: That was Ronnie Cuber on his one and only appearance on bass sax.

ctx.x: It just popped into my head, do you include — you know Paul Simon did that song called “You Can Call Me Al”?
Right. That was Ronnie Cuber on his one and only appearance on bass sax.
It’s so funny when I think — and then my daughter had this video clip of when Steve Martin did the song “King Tut”.
